law: engineering/05 §4.1 (the seed-panel protocol) and §19's prerequisites: a `seed_panel` of >= 16 fixed u64s checked into harness/scenarios/ and hashed. engineering/03 §7 rows it as `>= 16, fixed per run, recorded in gate_report.json`, gate G14(h).
rule: The panel is produced by one rule, never by a hand, so no member is a cherry-picked individual. Member 1 and member 2 are the two seeds the spec itself names: 0x51 is 05 §2's V0 reference seed and the seed every shipped scenario states; 0x0 is 05 §2's V8 control twin. Members 3..18 are the sixteen values u64::from_le_bytes(md5("SI-panel-<k>")[0..8]) for k = 0..15, in k order. `si-harness` re-derives this list from the rule and refuses a file whose members differ from it (G14.e.2's `no rejection sampling` law applies to the panel too: a panel chosen until a leg goes green is 05 §4.1 step 4's failure wearing a statistics costume).
rule_reimplementation: si_cli::harness::panel::rule_seeds — the code, not this file, is the authority; a reviewer can recompute either from the string above.
